newsitem.title: UK: Enterprise Oil sees output up to 320,000 BOE.
newsitem.headline: Enterprise Oil sees output up to 320,000 BOE.

text.p: Britain's Enterprise Oil said on Thursday it now expected its production to rise to over 320,000 barrels per day of oil equivalent by 1999.
This was a revision over earlier expectations of 300,000 barrels, the company said.
Enterprise' chairman Graham Hearne told shareholders at its annual meeting that the forecast took no account of further exploration successes or any changes in its portfolio of assets.

"Our overall development programme -- the most extensive in the group's history and the result of our successful exploration and appraisal effort -- has given us confidence to increase our production forecasts," Hearne said.
He said the company would invest about 160 million stg in its exploration programme which will cover its core areas, the UK Continental Shelf, Norway and Italy.
Enterprise will also carry out explorations in some of its emerging areas in the Gulf of Mexico and "riskier" areas of Ireland, Peru and the Black Sea.
